cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know this board game. I'll open with the horse in the lake; you can arrange your pieces after I've tested that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'm testing how the score responds before committing my playing pieces. Leave yours where I can see them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The marker isn't allowed to move. Shall I put it back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may restore it. A fixed score gives us a stable opening condition. Now hand me a playing piece; I'll begin the part of my strategy that moves.
